gloss: mental composure; peace of mind; emotional leeway

definitions.gloss: mental composure; peace of mind; emotional leeway
definitions.explanation: The state of having enough emotional or mental space to remain calm, considerate, and unhurried. The psychological capacity to handle situations without stress or panic.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no peace of mind.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to maintain mental composure.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しすぎて{心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized I had been too busy and had lost my peace of mind.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (heart, mind) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + ⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧ (room, margin, composure). A very common expression in modern Japanese, frequently used in self-help, work-life balance, and wellness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have mental composure
- {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack mental composure
- {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to maintain peace of mind
- {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose one's composure
- {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to regain peace of mind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気持|きも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧: emotional leeway — very similar, slightly more casual
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧: psychological composure — more formal/clinical
- ⟦ゆとり→ゆとり：10652_yutori⟧: room, margin — can also refer to mental/temporal slack

USAGE:
Often discussed in the context of ⟦{働|はたら}き{方改革|かたかいかく}→働き方改革：23313_hatarakikatakaikaku⟧ (work-style reform) and mental health awareness in Japan.
